# reselling_locations (Data Source)

Rootserver locations with their hardware clusters and bandwidth tiers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_locations" "fra" {
  name = "Frankfurt"
}

output "clusters" {
  value = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].clusters[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
